snp1.2:1.1: “I have prepared cooked rice and fresh milk,”
snp1.2:1.3: “I stay constantly at the shore of the great river,
snp1.2:1.4: “Where I have a roofed hut with a kindled fire;
snp1.2:1.5: “So if the gods wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:2.1: “I have no anger and no corruption,”
snp1.2:2.3: “I stay one night at the shore of the great river,
snp1.2:2.4: “In an open hut with the fire extinguished,
snp1.2:2.5: “So if the gods wish, they can make it rain.”
